# Pubroot Review Allowlist
#
# GitHub usernames listed here (one per line) are pre-approved for AI review
# without requiring the `approved-for-review` label from a maintainer.
#
# Use this for trusted contributors who are not repo collaborators but should
# have their submissions auto-reviewed (e.g., regular contributors, partner orgs).
#
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored.
# Blank lines are ignored.
# Usernames are case-insensitive.
#
# Example:
# buildngrowsv
# trusted-contributor
